name: Flash and photosensitivity blocker
summary: Block treatments whose temporal flash pattern has not passed a photosensitivity review.
refusalConditions: flash frequency or contrast has not been measured
qualityChecks: temporal flashes stay within the stated safety rule
failureModes: a short loop hides a repeated flash pattern

riskGates.basis: No automatic PSE measurement exists for arbitrary time-varying treatments.

safetyGates.basis: Unmeasured flash frequency or contrast must not be admitted.

provenance.claim: content should not flash more than three times per second

validation.notes: The policy is present; automatic PSE measurement is not implemented.
